reapack.name: StudioSync.lua
reapack.desc: StudioSync: record together remotely over a shared folder

version.author: James
version.changelog: StudioSync: the full rename. The ReaPack package, scripts, actions, repository and installers now carry the new name. If you installed it as BandSync, remove the BandSync repository in ReaPack and add this one.

version.author: James
version.changelog: A new install's ReaPack repository is called StudioSync, and the old name is switched off where it's found.

version.author: James
version.changelog: The nightly backup keeps its folders.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Deleting a copy can't freeze REAPER any more: it goes to the Recycle Bin in the background, with no hidden error box.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Clashes: the owner's change wins, and a Use mine button takes yours back straight from the message. New: colour the whole project, tracks by gradient, folder, instrument, person, newest work and more, and regions by section or along the song.

version.author: James
version.changelog: The classic panel is gone. New mirror tracks say (studio), old (band) ones still count. Several suggestions fold to one line with Review; each says what and how long ago; a grouped fader's suggestion says a folder or VCA goes straight through. Settings Health lists what needs you first, in columns when wide. Restore's filters fold when space is short. Studio cards sit side by side in a wide panel; project rows don't stretch. Driving isn't yellow. A panel failure now names itself in the console.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Track order is the same on every computer: whoever moves a track publishes the list, and each computer comes onto the newest one. A big restore runs in slices so REAPER keeps going, with one undo point. On a Mac, projects reopen at start with no load boxes, using REAPER's own -ignoreerrors (proven on Windows, needs a Mac test).

version.author: James
version.changelog: Produce: a button beside Follow and Listen. Hear someone record on your own grid as it happens, your song a moment behind theirs from your own copy, with Talk between takes; what's being sung over goes quiet here. By default over SonoBus with a position stamp and no server (new effects StudioSync stamp send and read); a NINJAM server is the other route. Colours: items by section, along the song, by person, lane or takes, and a live What's new view that fades over the hour.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Tailscale is back in the installers, not optional: the NINJAM route reaches its server over it. The server's address is saved as this computer's Tailscale name, which doesn't change. Health says if Tailscale isn't installed.
